The '''ancient transport center''' was a transporter built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] that was uncovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The transporter was located in the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
